title: How Far Did They Go? The Persuasive Tactics of Covert LLM Agents in a Discontinued Field Experiment

bias_targets.methodology: Structured content analysis using a schema-constrained LLM (LLaMA-3.3-70B) with human validation to identify and extract text spans exhibiting eight specific cognitive heuristics (Law of Small Numbers, Availability Heuristic, Representativeness Heuristic, Base-Rate Neglect, Attribute Substitution, Affect Heuristic, Confirmation Bias, and Illusion of Validity) within model-generated persuasive comments.
